name: LSA paper native 752M (0.50B core)
description: LSA as published, native version (Kubicek et al., arXiv 2610.42147, 30 Oct 2026; code github.com/Prefrontal-AI/latent-sparse-attention, native config default flavor Qwen3.5-0.8B, text only). 24 layers, width 1024: three Gated DeltaNet layers then one attention layer, six times. Only the attention layers use the LSA read (window 512, 4 sinks, buckets of ~8 inside 512-key blocks, top 1,024 keys in the code default; the paper reports 2,048–4,096 at long lengths). No notebook, no loop. Trained on 100B FineWeb-Edu tokens at 4k, then a 12B-token decay at 128k. Result in the paper: matches full attention at 128k (validation loss 1.085 = 1.085; RULER 32.2 vs 34.7). Dimensions from Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B config.json; the multi-token-prediction layer and vision tower are left out. We never trained this model. Parameters: 752,393,024 (text model, tied output), 498,113,344 without the word table (254,279,680). Check against the Hub: Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B lists 873.4M = this + the vision tower 100,592,896 + the prediction layer 20,452,864 (873,438,784; the safetensors index's 1,746,882,752 bytes match once the 18 linear layers' A_log and norm weights, stored in float32, are counted at 4 bytes).
